teaser: Models can draft two hundred decision policies; nobody can sign two hundred. Approve at altitude: each level may narrow the one above, never widen it.
core_idea: Decision policies scale through the fractal: decisions exist at every altitude, each level signs off once and is inherited below, every policy declares an envelope, and a lower level may narrow its parent but never widen it, a check that is mechanical for numbers and lists and model-assisted for words.
